verdict.rationale: Twenty documents a built-in AI chatbot that answers questions about CRM data. It also has AI agents that 'execute multi-step tasks autonomously' such as enriching records, run within the user's permission model, can be given scoped roles, and can be chained as an 'AI Agent' workflow step. That is direct, first-party support for delegating tasks to an in-product assistant. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agent delegation works in practice, detailed documentation of the range of actions agents can perform beyond enrichment and Q&A.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: AI agents that work autonomously within your CRM — answering questions, enriching records, and executing multi-step tasks within your permission model.
AI agents go beyond chat — they can execute multi-step tasks autonomously: Enrich records with data from external sources
Ask questions in natural language and the assistant retrieves and explains your CRM data for you.
You can assign specific roles to AI agents under **Settings → Members → Roles**, giving you full control over what data they can access and what actions they can perform.
